attackers_goals: Establish command and control channel. Propagate in the victim network.
description: Malicious actors can use Netcat for privilege escalation, remote code execution, data exfiltration and protocol tunneling to evade detection.
investigative_actions: Verify that the usage of Netcat/Netcat64 is from an authorized personnel and that user has the right to access the remote host.
name: Netcat makes or gets connections
